name: atslens
idea: ATSLens is a free browser-based ATS resume keyword optimizer — users paste a job description and their resume, and instantly get a match score, list of missing keywords, and actionable tips to beat automated resume screening systems.
why_trending: AI-powered ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems) now screen 98% of Fortune 500 job applications; searches for 'ATS resume checker' and 'beat ATS' have surged in 2026 as AI hiring tools proliferate. Jobscan.co, a direct competitor, has 5M+ registered users and charges $49/month.
why_profitable: Freemium model: free basic scoring with premium unlocks (unlimited saves, cover letter matcher, LinkedIn optimizer). Alternately high-CPM Google AdSense revenue from job-seeker traffic. Direct competitors Jobscan ($49/mo) and Resume Worded ($19/mo) validate strong willingness to pay.
why_easy: 100% client-side: JS tokenizes text, computes n-gram keyword matches, and renders results — zero backend required. No APIs, no databases, no auth. Pure HTML/CSS/JS single-page app that works offline and can be hosted free on GitHub Pages.
note: Demo code stored in idea-queue/apps/atslens/ because session token lacked repo-creation permissions. To launch: create github.com/PepeGoat/atslens repo and copy apps/atslens/index.html there, then enable GitHub Pages.
